steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to BookStack at http://127.0.0.1:8103/ using email admin@bench.local and password exactly the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (the browser fills it when typed). Verify that sign-in succeeded.
02-find: In the book named Bench Handbook, find and report the exact displayed names of all pages whose names start with 'Seed:'. Do not edit any pages.

03-create: Create and save a page named '{{runid}} Bench Page' with a single body paragraph that includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Ensure the paragraph appears only once; use Save Page so this is a real page, not only a draft. Report the saved page name and confirm the paragraph text from the saved page.

04-edit: Edit the saved page '{{runid}} Bench Page' so its only tag is the existing tag name 'Review Status' with existing value 'Approved'. Make sure not to use the similarly named 'Review State', and verify the saved page shows exactly this one name/value tag.

05-edit: Edit the saved page '{{runid}} Bench Page' and add a real heading labeled exactly 'Overview' to its body, preserving the existing single runid paragraph exactly once. Save the page and verify the saved body contains a heading element for Overview and still one paragraph.

06-archive: Move the saved page '{{runid}} Bench Page' into the chapter 'Release Notes' of the book 'Bench Handbook' (not the similarly named Bench Handbooks book and not Release Notes Archive). Complete the Move action and verify the saved page identifies both book and chapter as its location.

07-verify: On the page '{{runid}} Bench Page', post exactly one page comment whose text includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Verify the saved page displays exactly one comment and report its full text.

08-verify: On the saved page '{{runid}} Bench Page', verify the page URL shown by the app and report its final URL slug (the last path segment). Also confirm the page still shows its heading, paragraph, only tag, location and exactly one comment, without editing anything.
